texto: If a dime-sized black hole appeared in your pocket for five seconds,
you'd fall into your own pocket in 50 billionths of a second.
Because a black hole that small weighs as much as the entire Earth.
Within 4,000 miles, your pocket would pull harder than the whole planet,
so down would suddenly point sideways.
Everything within 125 miles, even the ground itself, would fall in after you.
But a black hole this small can't swallow that much that fast.
It chokes, and the pileup heats to millions of degrees.
A second sun, where your town used to be.
Then the black hole vanishes, and all that crushed burning matter explodes back out,
leaving a crater twice as wide as the one that killed the dinosaurs.
But on the bright side, time stops at the edge of a black hole.
So for five seconds, you had the whole world in your pocket.
